title: (As Nana Weda) Looking after Weda
titleFa: (در نقش Nana Weda) مراقبت از ودا

branches.suggestion: Oh, it's you, love. I'm afraid I've come down with the flu. Would you mind closing that window?
branches.suggestionFa: آه، تویی عزیزم. متأسفانه آنفلوآنزا گرفتم. اشکالی نداره اون پنجره را ببندی؟

r2.speaker: mehdi
r2.text: Of course not. Shall I get you another blanket too?

translations.fa: معلومه که نه. یه پتوی دیگه هم بیارم؟

branches.suggestion: Since Tuesday. William's been an angel, but he can't cook. Would you mind making some soup?
branches.suggestionFa: از سه‌شنبه. ویلیام فرشته بوده، ولی آشپزی بلد نیست. اشکالی نداره یه سوپ درست کنی؟

r3.speaker: mehdi
r3.text: I'd be happy to. What kind would you like?

translations.fa: با کمال میل. چه نوعی دوست دارید؟

branches.suggestion: Ooh, that would be wonderful. And could you possibly ring the surgery for me? I've got an appointment I can't make.
branches.suggestionFa: اوه، عالی میشه. و ممکنه به مطب زنگ بزنی؟ یه وقت دارم که نمی‌تونم برم.

r4.speaker: mehdi
r4.text: Of course. Shall I ask them to rebook it?

branches.suggestion: Rebooking is fine — next week, if they can. I don't want to be any trouble.
branches.suggestionFa: دوباره وقت گرفتن خوبه — هفتهٔ بعد، اگه بشه. نمی‌خوام زحمت بدم.

r5.speaker: mehdi
r5.text: You're no trouble at all, Weda.

branches.suggestion: You're a treasure. Would you mind passing my glasses? I want to finish my crossword before I nod off.
branches.suggestionFa: تو گنجی. اشکالی نداره عینکم را بدی؟ می‌خوام قبل از چرت زدن جدولم را تموم کنم.

r6.speaker: mehdi
r6.text: Here you are. Do you want help with it?

branches.suggestion: Go on then. Seven across: "a hot drink, three letters". Even I know that one — tea!
branches.suggestionFa: خب بخون. افقی هفت: «یه نوشیدنی داغ، سه حرف». اینو حتی من می‌دونم — چای!

r7.speaker: mehdi
r7.text: Thanks, Nana Weda! See you later.
